name: tripwire
description: Smart Contract Financial Guardian - a Zodiac Guard for Safe wallets that monitors, scores, and blocks/delays/freezes risky transactions before they execute

scripts.dev:healthcheck: wait-on -t 90000 -i 1000 http-get://localhost:3001/health http-get://localhost:3002/audit/health http-get://localhost:3003/health http-get://localhost:5173/app/ http-get://localhost:3000 http-get://localhost:3000/app/ && echo [dev:all] site on http://localhost:3000 - dashboard on http://localhost:3000/app/
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names orch,audit,sim,dash,site,check -c blue,magenta,yellow,green,cyan,gray "npm --prefix backend run orchestrator" "npm --prefix backend run audit" "npm --prefix backend run sim" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm run dev:site" "npm run dev:healthcheck"
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix frontend run build:site && npm --prefix site run build
